producer_judgment.rationale: Both are distinct Performance Objectives in the same PRIMARY TWO Topic '1. Money' (objectives 1 and 3 of one topic row), sharing Theme, Sub-Theme, and grade rank. The first, 'enumerate the uses of money,' is foundational conceptual understanding of what money is for; the second, 'change money up to ₦20 into small units and shop with money not greater than ₦20,' is a more complex transactional application. Proficiency in recognizing money's uses plausibly supports success in practical money-changing and shopping, giving a permitted same-rank developmental direction (first_to_second). Shared 'money' tokens/tags alone would not suffice, but the conceptual-foundation-to-application progression within the same Money topic is pair-specific and substantive.
